newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange to list two new firms.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange to list two new firms.

text.p: Partial shares of two Turkish firms, biscuits and chocolate cookie producer Anadolu Gida Sanayii A.S. and textile firm Bisas Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. will be listed on the Istanbul Stock Exchange's national market from October 28, the Exchange said in a statement.
The shares of Anadolu Gida, owned by Turkey's leading biscuit group Ulker, will start trading at a price of 27,500 lira per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share.

T.Ekonomi Bankasi which led the consortium in Anadolu Gida's public offer last week, said the whole offer of 11.42 billion lira nominal-valued shares, or five percent of the firm's capital, was sold to 9,110 domestic individual investors.
Shares of Bisas will begin trade at 5,200 lira per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share.
Bisas's 42 billion lira worth shares, making up 20.19 percent of its capital, were sold to public last week.

Consortium leader Korfezbank said 24.94 billion lira of the offer was bought by 1,608 domestic individual investors, 9.21 billion by seven domestic institutional investors and 7.85 billion by three foreigners, including the U.S. based Dupont Pension Fund Inv. which bought five billion lira worth shares.
